question: Should the remaining Signal behavior be fixed inside the Signal transport, following the merged iMessage precedent, or should OpenClaw expose a new global `messages` placeholder-policy setting?
rationale: Both approaches can remove the visible caption, but they create different long-term contracts: a Signal-owned transport fix is narrower, while a global option expands strict configuration and cross-channel policy.

options.title: Fix Signal Transport
options.body: Remove the synthetic visible caption for media-only Signal sends using a transport-safe fallback and retain no new global configuration surface.

options.title: Add Global Setting
options.body: Introduce a documented default-preserving `messages` option and define consistent placeholder behavior, schema metadata, tests, and upgrade semantics across affected channels.

recommendation.title: Fix Signal Transport
recommendation.body: Remove the synthetic visible caption for media-only Signal sends using a transport-safe fallback and retain no new global configuration surface.
